text: **dsh-neu-theme** 为 DSH Web 注册 Neu Light 与 Neu Dark 两套主题，并在「设置 → 通用」提供色板切换。浅色采用奶油暖白，深色采用墨蓝；插件为侧栏、消息气泡、输入区、工具行、思考行及代码块添加轻拟物阴影和颗粒纹理，并为输入区、菜单和对话框加入磨砂效果。节点淡入、气泡悬浮等动效遵循系统减少动态效果设置。选择 Default 会清除插件样式并还原 DSH 外观。适合希望更换并保存网页主题的用户；需要兼容的 DSH Web Host 设置支持，不需 API Key 或外部账号。

**dsh-neu-theme** adds cream Neu Light and ink-blue Neu Dark to DSH Web. A Settings picker saves choices through Host settings. Soft shadows, grain, and frosted menus restyle chat. Motion respects system preferences; Default restores the built-in appearance. No API key or external account needed.

dsh-neu-theme 的功能「浅色与深色主题」：注册 Neu Light 与 Neu Dark 两组 DSH 色彩 token。用户从主题设置选择后，由 ThemeRuntime 应用对应的奶油暖白或墨蓝配色。
dsh-neu-theme 的功能「主题选择器」：在设置通用项目中加入 Default、Neu Light 与 Neu Dark 色板按钮。点击后立即切换主题，并将自定义选择写入 Host 设置；选 Default 会清除该偏好。
dsh-neu-theme 的功能「轻拟物界面效果」：为侧栏、聊天气泡、代码块、工具行和思考行添加分层阴影、渐变高光或细颗粒纹理，让 DSH Web 内容表面呈现柔和的浮起与内凹感。
dsh-neu-theme 的功能「磨砂玻璃效果」：输入区通过伪元素显示半透明模糊层，菜单和对话框使用独立 backdrop blur。视觉层与弹层分开处理，可让弹层继续采样页面背景。
dsh-neu-theme 的功能「微交互」：对话节点出现时淡入，消息气泡悬停上浮，输入区在悬停或键盘聚焦时加深内凹，工具与思考行悬停时增强阴影；动画仅在系统允许动态效果时启用。
dsh-neu-theme 的功能「恢复默认外观」：选择 Default 后恢复 DSH 内置配色，移除主题插件注入的样式节点和 body 标记，并清除已保存的自定义主题字段。
dsh-neu-theme 使用前须知：README 宣称对话画布有环境顶光和角落补光，但当前 CSS 明确让画布保持均匀背景，仅保留颗粒纹理；侧栏另有渐变与阴影效果。

A Neumorphism (soft-UI) theme plugin for **DeepSeek Harness web** — gentle
raised-and-recessed surfaces in a cream light palette and an ink-dark
palette, complete with ambient lighting, material gloss, grain texture,
glassmorphism and micro-interactions.

中文说明见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)。

dsh-neu-theme README · Features：- **Two themes** registered into the built-in ThemeRuntime:
  - `neu-light` — cream warm-white canvas, soft slate-blue accent
  - `neu-dark` — ink-blue night canvas, luminous indigo accent
- **Lighting** — ambient top glow + corner fill painted on the visible
  surfaces (conversation canvas, sidebar, details column), not just body.
- **Material** — three-layer shadows (contact + cast + top-edge highlight),
  145° gloss gradients aligned to the light direction, code blocks with a
  backlit inner wall.
- **Texture** — fine grayscale grain (inline SVG feTurbulence) over the
  canvas, sidebar, details column and code blocks.
- **Glassmorphism** — the composer capsule and its popovers (permission
  menu, model menu, context panel) share one frosted-glass language: the
  card's blur lives on a `::before` pseudo-layer so the nested popovers
  keep their own real `backdrop-filter` blur (the card is not their
  backdrop root).
- **Micro-interactions** — conversation nodes fade in on mount, bubbles
  lift on hover, the composer recess deepens on hover/focus, tool rows and
  reasoning rows strengthen on hover; all gated under

dsh-neu-theme README · Install：Install the published package into a dsh profile (works with the `web`
profile):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-neu-theme

dsh-neu-theme README · or install manually in the web profile:：cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm add dsh-neu-theme
```

The package is also available on [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-neu-theme).

Then add `"dsh-neu-theme"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's
`package.json`, and restart `dsh web`.
section: or install manually in the web profile:

text:
dsh-neu-theme README · or install manually in the web profile:：Once running: **Settings → General → Neumorphism theme** → pick
**Default / Neu Light / Neu Dark**. The choice is stored in the Host settings
namespace `dsh-neu-theme` (normally `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`); choose **Default**
to return to the built-in appearance.

The Host-backed settings path requires DSH Web Host `0.1.1-rc.2` or newer.
Remote browsers cannot access the loopback settings API, so their selection
remains process-local by design.
section: or install manually in the web profile:

dsh-neu-theme README · Develop：```sh
npm run build   # regenerates lib/client.js from src/client.tpl.js + themes/*.json
npm run check   # syntax-checks the built bundles
```

While `dsh web` runs with the HMR chain mounted, rebuilding
`lib/client.js` is picked up by the polling watcher and hot-reloads only
this plugin's fiber.
